name: cr603_4_carpet_of_flowers_once_per_turn
why: CR 603.4: Carpet of Flowers' 'if you haven't added mana with this ability this turn' (the trigger's ResolvedLimit$ 1) is an intervening if: once it has added mana in the first main phase it doesn't trigger in the second, and it triggers again the next turn (Carpet of Flowers' ResolvedLimit$)
